sql: SELECT count(*) active_artworks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) with_primary,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.primary_media_id IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NULL) dangling_primary,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.primary_media_id IS NOT NULL AND m.storage_path ~ '^/assets/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif)$') supported_primary,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.work_type='painting') paintings,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.work_type='painting' AND m.storage_path ~ '^/assets/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif)$') supported_paintings FROM artworks a LEFT JOIN media_assets m ON m.id=a.primary_media_id WHERE a.status<>'archived'
